newsitem.title: INDIA: India sees 96/97 GDP rise at least equal to 95/96.
newsitem.headline: India sees 96/97 GDP rise at least equal to 95/96.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Thursday that 1996/97 (April-March) gross domestic product (GDP) is expected to grow at least as fast as in 1995/96.

"I believe we are on course," Chidambaram told the Confederation of Indian Industry's annual meeting in the eastern city of Calcutta. "India's GDP, I believe, will grow at least at the rate at which it grew last year."
The government's tentative estimate of GDP growth in 1995/96 over 1994/95 is 6.6 percent.
Last month, Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda was quoted as saying GDP was expected to grow 6.5 percent in 1996/97 over the previous fiscal year.
